rv.t: You must do this! Sunsets, gelato and CBD views! This is truly one of Auckland's best kept secrets. We took the ferry from downtown Auckland over to Devonport and then walked through the village up to watch the sunset. We stopped along the way for gelato at the Vic Theatre, finishing the last lick just as we reached the top. Perfect timing! In Autumn the sun sets a little more north than we had anticipated but still…

Takarunga / Mount Victoria offers some of the most spectacular 360-degree views in Auckland and is an absolute must-do when visiting Devonport. The walk to the summit is very manageable and pleasant, winding up through lush green slopes and past the iconic colorful "mushrooms" (which are actually decorated vents for the water pumping station). Once you reach the top, the reward is incredible. You get a perfect…

A less popular spot compared to Mount Eden for viewing of the skyline, but the experience worths it. The experience was pleasant from the moment you stepped onto the ferry bound for Devonport. The hike is not too strenuous and the view includes the sea part, which stood it out of the crowd. Only few people are here during weekdays. Some fascinating stores are along the street heading to the mountain including…

The museum and cafe are near by too. Great day out. And…

I always start with oysters — they taste extra fresh here. Drinks and desserts are also really great. Overall one of my favorite restaurants in the Seattle area. They r so killing it. Location is nice for walking on the beach…

Food was great - I had the Surf n’ Turf with a 5 oz filet and shrimp. The sauce was incredible on both. My husband had crab cakes and also were delicious although he wishes there was more sauce. Fresh oysters on the half shell were 10/10. Downside for us was the service. The gentleman who served us did just under the bare minimum and we felt like he was annoyed by our presence the whole time. We were the last…

We went to Salt & Iron for brunch to celebrate a friend’s birthday and it was so good! Everything we ordered was delicious, and it just felt like the perfect spot to sit, relax, and enjoy the morning together. The location is perfect, and the decor is thoughtful and welcoming...such a great place to settle in and enjoy a relaxed brunch. It really was the perfect place to celebrate, and everyone in our group loved…

48.a: Togoshiginzaekizen Dental Clinic, グローバル戸越銀座ビル ４階 1 Chome-9-1 Hiratsuka, Shinagawa City, Tokyo 142-0051, Japan
48.aj: 〒142-0051 東京都品川区平塚１丁目９−１ グローバル戸越銀座ビル ４階 戸越銀座駅前歯科

rv.t: 2ヶ月ほど前に別の歯科医院でホワイトニングをしましたが、その時より照射時間も短いのに、終わった後に白くなったのを実感できました。施術中も、口内処置や声かけしてくださり、安心出来ました。親切で丁寧ですが、テキパキ働かれている雰囲気印象的でした。 痛みもなく、効果もすぐ実感出来たので白さキープのために通いたいと思います。
初めてホワイトニングで利用させて頂きました。ご担当頂いた衛生士さんは予約の段階からとても丁寧で施術前も解りやすいご説明で安心して受けられました。またホワイトニングもクリーニングをした後にして下さるのでトーンアップしたと共に本当に歯が綺麗になりました。これからも通わせて頂きます。ありがとうございました!

キレイパスのホワイトニングだけなら良しだが普通の歯科は完全にアウト。予約時間より早めに来てと言われ行くが30分待たされ、同じく待ってる方で溢れていて座るところもなく待合室で立ちっぱなし、歯科衛生士はタイミーですか？ころころ毎日変わっていて予約を取れる衛生士が限られているのかその人がクリーニングに入ってると急に担当変更、まともに引き継ぎもせずに中途半端に施術されました。常にバタバタしていて回ってないのが丸見えです。若い衛生士さん、口調強くて怖いです。あんなに予約があるのに派遣の先生1人。オペレーションしっかりして下さい。院長は若い男性ですが荒いので毎回口内炎が出来ます。近所だったので通ってましたがさすがにもう行きません

48.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00

49.a: Japan, 〒142-0042 Tokyo, Shinagawa City, Yutakacho, 1 Chome−4−18 ルーデンス戸越 1階 NagiCrepe
49.aj: 〒142-0042 東京都品川区豊町１丁目４−１８ ルーデンス戸越 1階 NagiCrepe
49.ed: People say this crepe shop offers delicious vegan and gluten-free crepes made with soy milk cream, rice flour, and oatmeal, with many highlighting the seasonal and savory options. They also mention the crepes are satisfying yet light, and appreciate the reasonable prices. Others also like the friendly staff and the convenient benches available for waiting or eating.
49.edj: このクレープ店について、豆乳クリーム、米粉、オートミールを使ったヴィーガン・グルテンフリーのクレープが美味しいと評判です。季節限定のクレープや、食事系のクレープを評価する声も多くあります。クレープは満足感があるのに軽く、価格も手頃だと好評です。また、スタッフの対応が親しみやすく、店内で待ったり食べたりできるベンチがあるのも良いというクチコミがあります。

rv.t: We ordered multiple vegan crepes. They were all creamy and flavorful. We highly recommend this place.

Finding a gluten free vegan crepe is not easy and this place has you covered! Super delicious crepes and always has a fun and yummy changing seasonal menu. Don’t miss this place! And the ginza it is in is super rad.
Absolutely delicious crepes! You can really feel the care, passion, and affection the chef puts into every single one. Made with love and great attention to detail. Highly recommended!

49.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 12:30

50.a: Nadai Hiden no Aji Tako Ichi Togoshiginza, 1 Chome-17-9 Togoshi, Shinagawa City, Tokyo 142-0041, Japan
50.aj: 〒142-0041 東京都品川区戸越１丁目１７−９ 名代秘伝の味たこ一 戸越銀座店
50.ed: Diners like this takoyaki shop's fluffy and gooey takoyaki with generous octopus pieces, and appreciate the option to eat in with affordable drink sets. Other reviews mention service can be unprofessional and the takoyaki can be bland.
50.edj: このたこ焼き店を利用した人は、ふわふわとろとろのたこ焼きに大きめのタコが入っている点を評価しています。手頃な価格のドリンクセットで店内で食べられる点も好評のようです。 一方で、店員の対応が丁寧ではないというクチコミや、たこ焼きの味が薄いという意見もあります。

rv.t: First time having takoyaki and it won’t be the last. Was made fast and delicious.

旅行で東京を訪れました ２日目のお昼ごはんは名代秘伝の味たこ一戸越銀座店さんです 戸越銀座は一昨年くらいにはじめて訪れ たくさんお店があってすごくいい場所だと思っていました ですので今回は事前にお店を決めず 歩きながらお昼ごはんを頂くところを探します 商店街入口の古着やさんでお安くニットを購入し 雑貨やさんですてきなお皿を見つけられましたが ごはんはいろいろ迷います この日は気温が低く北海道から来ているわたしでも 外でビールを飲むのはちょっと避けたい感じです お店を探し行ったり来たりしますが こちらのたこ一さんはイートインがあること たこ焼き４つにビールがついて550円というお値段が決め手で お店に入らせて頂きます 店内はカウンター席が６つです たこ焼きの味やソースが選べますが オーソドックスにソース味のたこ焼きに トッピングは辛子マヨネーズとしました 焼き上がりまで少し待ちます その間にもテイクアウトのお客様が次々来られ…

rv.a: 温泉YouTubeグレイトプレゼンター癒し王ふじ
rv.t: 11月セールで安かったので購入。８個で税込390円でした。キャッシュレスも可。店内カウンターで食べる場合は別途ワンドリンク注文要。 たこ焼きは、大きめ、外側はパリっとせずに柔らかいタイプ、中はトロトロ、生地の粉の味はイマイチで味がしない、具は小さいタコのみ（他の具の味がほとんどしない）、サービス対応も良いとは言えず

51.a: Japan, 〒120-0034 Tokyo, Adachi City, Senju, 5 Chome−6−7 TSUJI －お茶とかき氷－
51.aj: 〒120-0034 東京都足立区千住５丁目６−７ TSUJI －お茶とかき氷－
51.ed: Diners like this cafe's complex and visually appealing kakigori, which features a variety of seasonal ingredients and unique flavor combinations, and appreciate that the menu is updated on Instagram. Other reviews mention the menu can be unclear, and the service can be inefficient.
51.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーは、様々な旬の食材やユニークな味の組み合わせが特徴の、複雑で見た目にも美しいかき氷を高く評価しています。メニューがInstagramで更新されることにも感謝の声が寄せられています。 一方で、メニューが分かりにくい、サービスが非効率的だというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: Very beautiful and complex kakigori. Ice is packed a little tight for my taste. Inside is only 5 seats, so they fill up basically if anybody shows up.

Small, cozy cafe serving kakigori in a very residential area of kitasenju. The ice could be a little more fine grained but overall a positive experience. I tried pistachio - chocolate and pine-kiwi kakigori. Both of them were really good. They only have about 3 tables. So could get crowded pretty quickly. Take out is also possible. Price ranges from 1000-1500yen.
High quality and tasty kakigori. Make sure you check the opening times/dates which they publish on Instagram.

52.a: Archi-Depot, WHAT MUSEUM 寺田倉庫 G号 2 Chome-6-10 Higashishinagawa, Shinagawa City, Tokyo 140-0002, Japan
52.aj: 〒140-0002 東京都品川区東品川２丁目６−１０ 寺田倉庫 G号 WHAT MUSEUM 建築倉庫 ARCHI-DEPOT
52.ed: Museum displaying architectural models showing built & unbuilt structures of varying significance.
52.edj: 建築模型を展示している博物館。さまざまなテーマの建築済み、未建築の構造物を展示している。

rv.t: If you are an architect or just a fan of model making you can not miss this museum full of fantastic models it's an architects dream. Be sure not to miss the storage room tour (hours are located in the main entrance information desk). In the tour they give you a lantern and let you wander freely in a pitch black storage room full of models including ones from top architectural firms.
Very interesting large permanent collection of architectural models, in addition to the seasonal exhibitions.

rv.a: Htike Aung Kyaw (ထိုက်အောင်ကျော်)
rv.t: Really nice place to spend some time. Cool Architecture Models. Had a really nice time there. But seems a little dark to me. Was expecting the room to be a little more brighter so I could easily take some photographs. The doors at the entrance are huge and cool too...

catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
53.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious ramen and fluffy shaved ice, with seasonal fruit toppings and unique sparkling options. They also highlight the clean interior, convenient waiting area, and friendly staff. Some reviews mention the prices can be high.
53.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、美味しいラーメンとふわふわのかき氷が高く評価されています。季節のフルーツがのったかき氷や、珍しいスパークリングのかき氷も人気のようです。また、清潔な店内や便利な待合スペース、感じの良いスタッフも好評です。 一方で、値段が少し高いという意見もあります。

rv.t: It's summer in Tokyo, time to hunt for kakigori. This one was not bad at all. I like the softness of the shaved ice, the taste of the rare cheese, and of course the fruit toppings (peach and grape). Although their peach syrup was not my cup of tea. The service and ambiance were nice. They only have menu in Japanese without any picture though. So I just asked them which one is their most popular kakigori.

People come here for the year round kakigori, but don't sleep on the tomato cheese ramen! Pretty good. Imagine ramen in creamy tomato soup 🍅🍲🍜. Kakigori flavors seem to change very often. But the constant seems to be strawberry 🍓 🍧. Inside are a few tables, you have to order at the counter before you sit, and you cannot order more later. There's usually a line outside, but the wait isn't so bad. ↔️ Social distanced…

Visit for shaved ice. The store is light and clean with comfortable space. Cozy and relax. Ordered mango and passion fruit flavor. The combination of sweet and sour is delicious. The aroma of ripped mango is good too. The portion size is just right. Price reasonable. Friendly service. Not crowded. Recommended.

rv.t: 青ブタとのコラボで訪れました。 店内は席が10席（8席はテーブル、2席はカウンター）なので、予約可能であれば予約することをオススメします。 ジェノベーゼパスタは普通に美味しく頂きました（よくあるジェノベーゼパスタかなって味）。ドリンクもコラボカフェで飲んだことあるような味や初めての味のドリンクもあって美味しかったです！ デザートのグラスムースが一番美味しかったです！仕事終わりに寄ったので、糖分を体が欲していたから、ペロッと食べてしまいました！見た目、味どちらもexcellentでした！ フレンチトーストはクリームと蜂蜜がいい感じにトーストと合わさっり、脳が糖分補給できて喜ぶ甘さです！ ここのお店はデザートが美味しいですね！ 店内の装飾はお洒落な感じで、アニメとのコラボしてるのがちょっと驚き。…

こちらのお店を期間限定で貸し切り「青春ブタ野郎」のコラボカフェが開催されており利用。 開催期間の告知を始め情報発信はプリンセスカフェのSNSにて行われていました。 注文に使うオーダーシートなどもプリンセスカフェのものが使用されていたので普段のお店の仕様とは違っていたと思われます。 店内がコラボ仕様に装飾されておりグッズやキャラクターのスタンドパネルが展示されていました。 キャラクター等身大のパネルは大きくグッズを置いた分店内は狭くなっており少し窮屈感はありました。 入店時に奥から傘立てをわざわざ出して保管してくれるなど接客は丁寧。 海外のお客さんも同席していましたがオーダーの説明などもまた丁寧に行っておりスタッフさんの気遣いが随所に感じられました。
野菜やフルーツがたっぷりで、料理が全部旨いです！ 店内雰囲気も良く、落ち着くし気取ってないから長居しちゃいます。 立地的に人通りが少なくて、ちょっと勿体無いなって思う反面、隠れ家的な感じで誰にも知られたくなかったりw 散歩がてら、ふらっとリラックスしに来たくなるお店です。

55.a: Pedra Branca Togoshi Ginza, 池田屋ビル 1階 2 Chome-14-8 Hiratsuka, Shinagawa City, Tokyo 142-0051, Japan
55.aj: 〒142-0051 東京都品川区平塚２丁目１４−８ 池田屋ビル 1階 ペドラブランカ 戸越銀座店
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店

rv.t: We were super excited to try this place out and went there for a light dinner. Unfortunately, even though the cafe is open until 8pm, the gluten free pancakes are only made fresh and served between 10am and 5pm. So we had to settle for the wrapped pancakes to go. They seem quite soft so we think they will be good, but will update when we try it shortly.

The pancakes are made with rice flour, and according to the staff, it takes 30 minutes to prepare one order. At first, I thought the wait was too long, but after 30 minutes, when I finally tasted the sweet and savory pancakes, I felt it was worth it. The texture was something I had never experienced before—very surprising, high-quality, and delicious. The caramel coffee was also very good. If I have the chance next…

We all gathered here after Konparuyu（Public-bath). The shop has lots of greenery in front of it, and the inside is stylish, spacious, and very comfortable. The pancakes are made from rice flour and the butter is soy milk-based, and all the ingredients are healthy and delicious! The sauna drinks is also particular excellent!! We can enjoy gathering at after-sauna and enjoying delicious, healthy food, making it the…

rv.t: The oyster spaghetti and beef tenderloin spaghetti are incredibly tasty; we ordered a variety of dishes, but they were so good that we didn't have time to take photos. I highly recommend them for lunch or dinner. The atmosphere of the restaurant was inviting, with warm lighting and friendly staff that made the experience even more enjoyable. Each dish was beautifully presented, and the flavors were well-balanced…

After staying here for 3 months, I feel the places I've eaten at can't match with the combination of herbs and spices served in the dishes from this restaurant/cafe. It is required to order a drink with the dishes, that said, I'd like to try every single dish here once I'm able to read them. The chai is heavy on the ginger side but it was real nice because it was a rainy autumn night. My first cuisine with pink…

Gratin and quiche is their specialty, and all the varieties of them that we've tried here have tasted great. They also have a local craft beer on draft that's pretty good. A bit on the pricey side, so I only come here every now and then for a nice brunch or lunch.

57.a: Japan, 〒142-0064 Tokyo, Shinagawa City, Hatanodai, 5 Chome−6−10 YGフラッグ 1F Chilling Coffee&Bake
57.aj: 〒142-0064 東京都品川区旗の台５丁目６−１０ YGフラッグ 1F Chilling Coffee&Bake
57.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious homemade sweets, including the popular Eton Mess parfait and rich carrot cake, and appreciate the option to take them out. They also highlight the cozy, antique-style interior and the friendly, attentive staff.
57.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、人気のイートンメスパフェや濃厚なキャロットケーキなど、自家製スイーツの美味しさが高く評価されています。テイクアウトもできる点が喜ばれています。また、居心地の良いアンティーク調の店内や、親しみやすく気の利くスタッフも好評のようです。

rv.t: I don’t write reviews often but when I do it usually means that the location was amazing. We came around 3pm but the seats were full but the man at the counter offered to take our phone number and call us when seats opened up. It doesn’t sound like much but out of all the cafes I’ve been to they do not do this. It was a man in glasses doing all the work. Making coffee, taking orders, serving customers, taking phone…

A super cozy little coffee shop with about 6 seats only. There’s a nice, chill vibe about the place with soothing music in the background. Since it was hot, I went with the iced coffee and it was fantastic. The carrot cake was quite nice as well, with a moist center and a creamy frosting that felt similar to ones back home. The service was nice and staff friendly. I’ll be back for sure and really want to try their…

It’s nice to see cafes like this in the area with eclectic pastries and 3rd wave coffee. Sadly the spacing was a bit too cramped for appreciation — whenever I visit, there’s a maximum capacity of around 4-5 people max so I never get a seat. This time I ordered an iced americano to-go, but it was quite watered down and for the price of around 400-500 yen was a bit of a letdown. Didn’t get any of the desserts but I’ll…

rv.t: I've been here at least 5 times and the kakigori here does not disappoint at all. Flavours and layout are rather traditional, which I find quite endearing. Service staff are always hospitable and attentive, which makes every visit incredibly enjoyable. I wish this establishment continued success.

Not bad. The pork was super tasty. My only criticism is that they might want to display a more sanitary image by separating their cooking and serving staff. One of the, what I assumed, confectioners served us. But his apron was covered with white powder (rice flour maybe?). He’s probably a clean guy, but it’s just better not to come out and serve the customers with anything but a clean apron and clean appearance.

An old traditional Japanese confectionary that serves, among its other Japanese confections, the best shaved ice in Tokyo (in my personal opinion). There definitely is a texture difference between the regular and "natural" ice. The latter is smoother and has less of that icy sharp texture in your mouth. Worth the extra hundred yen in my opinion. There are excellent seasonal shaved ice flavors, but you definitely…

59.edj: かき氷やフレンチ トーストを、お茶や自家製スープと味わえるシンプルなデザート ショップ。

Objectively speaking, the dessert itself was pretty good though some may find it a bit pricey for what is essentially shaved ice and every customer has to order at least one main item from the menu The peach shaved ice had more layers to the flavours compared to the watermelon one, with a creme brulee-like topping on…

Azuki to Kouri is a place you really need to plan ahead for. Reservations are required in advance and seats are very limited, so make sure to book early. You really cannot come to Tokyo without stopping here. The atmosphere feels more like a dessert bar than a typical dessert shop. It is quiet, intimate, and very thoughtfully designed. Sitting at the counter and watching the kakigori being prepared feels like…

We came to Japan to try kakigori - having first tried it at Ivan's ramen in Manhattan. (To be clear regarding a previous reviewer - we have had fantastic shave ice in Hawaii many times, but kakigori is not shave ice.
